name: Traccia EN
summary:
Bring your creative ideas into your space with Traccia EN, a mixed reality tool for planning and creating murals and sculptures.

Load an image from your headset, place it on a wall and adjust its position, size and transparency. In Room mode, extend your image across recognized walls.

Before locking the image, fine-tune its depth and tilt so it sits flush with the wall. Check the alignment from the front and from the side. If you have already traced a line, use it as a reference.
